name: Worn, Cropped
description: A tight crop on a single body part — a wrist, hand, neck, or ear — wearing or holding the product, so its true real-world scale reads instantly. No full face, no full body, just the product in genuine natural use.
lighting: Soft directional light, true skin tone
subject: either
prompt: a tight crop isolating a single body part relevant to how the product is actually worn or held — a wrist, a hand, the side of a neck, or an ear — with the product shown in genuine natural use at true-to-life scale, soft single-direction light giving real skin-tone rendering and authentic soft shadow falloff, shallow depth of field keeping the product and the immediately adjacent skin tack-sharp while the frame edges soften gently, a plain softly blurred neutral background with no discernible location or props, no face in frame, no second body part competing for attention, natural relaxed positioning rather than a stiff studio pose, genuine editorial product-in-use intimacy
